messages:
elaine: @channel Quick heads-up — we're updating telemetry and data retention defaults for Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments. This goes into effect in 30 days. TL;DR: default telemetry = opt-out for Private, 90d telemetry retention, 365d audit logs as an add-on, and stronger consent flow for shared-support debugging. Docs + rollout below. :loudspeaker:

samir: question — does this change require infra config changes or is it just a console/default flag? any migration steps?

elaine: Good q. Two pieces: (1) Default policy change (console + API flag) — customers who upgrade will see the new default set to opt-out for Private deployments. No forced data movement. (2) For on-prem/air-gapped installs we will not ship telemetry off-box unless the customer explicitly enables remote telemetry during install or later. No retroactive export of customer data.

elaine: Rollout plan: staged -> beta -> GA
- This week: pilot with 10 existing Private customers who agreed to help validate consent modal and opt-in flows.
- +7 days: beta group (invite-based) — CSM/SEs will get invite list.
- +30 days: GA — default policy active for new Private deployments and upgrades (admins will see the toggle and consent history).

ops-bot: Reminder: rollout checklist created: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-telemetry-rollout (private link). Items: UI toggle, consent modal, audit log retention flag, support playbook, customer email templates.

samir: can we get the CLI/API example for teams that script installs?

elaine: yes — example CLI to set explicit telemetry choice on an existing deployment:
```bash
# set telemetry opt-out for deployment "prod-west"
redwood private update --deployment prod-west --telemetry opt-out

# set telemetry opt-in and forward telemetry to remote endpoint
redwood private update --deployment prod-west --telemetry opt-in --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.mycorp.example
```
Note: for on-prem air-gapped installs the --telemetry-endpoint flag will be rejected unless the installer has enabled remote-export in the install profile.

ryan-privacy: Legal & privacy checked this. Key notes: (a) We updated the DPA language to call out telemetry types (metrics, sampling kernel traces, anonymized error stacks), (b) customers can request deletion of collected telemetry within 30 days of their request, (c) SOC2 scope updated to include telemetry pipelines for hosted/private-managed cases. For strictly air-gapped installs we only record local logs unless the customer opts to share them. I'll publish an FAQ for Sales/SEs.

maria-csm: What should CSMs tell customers who ask about compliance & FedRAMP/IL5?

elaine: Talk track for CSMs/SEs: be explicit — default for Private is opt-out, we respect region/residency, audit logs retention can be extended via add-on, and we will not exfiltrate data from air-gapped installs. If customers need FedRAMP-level artifacts or longer retention, route to enterprise sales and security review. I'll share a two-paragraph support blurb and a canned email.

maria-csm: ok thanks — please drop the canned email and FAQ in the CSM kit.

deploy-bot: Beta group deployment window scheduled: 2026-05-03 02:00-04:00 UTC — config flag rollout only, no infra restart expected.

elaine: Action items:
- @samir please confirm CLI validation for --telemetry-endpoint by EOD tomorrow.
- @ryan-privacy follow up with CSM FAQ + legal blurb (ETA 3 business days).
- @maria-csm we'll add the customer email + support script to the kit once FAQ is ready.

samir: on it. will validate CLI and CI tests.

ryan-privacy: will draft FAQ and share for review.

maria-csm: ack, will prep outreach list for pilot customers.

elaine: Thanks all — posting a short summary + public docs link when GA is live. If anyone needs access to the pilot checklist or wants to join the beta review, DM me. :thumbsup:
